summary: Maps a team index a3 (1-17) to a season-specific team id by probing the resolved season database path against four GDB filename literals (F11999.GDB, F12000.GDB, F12001.GDB, F12002.GDB) and dispatching through one of four jump-table switch tables with base ids 333, 334, 335 or 336 (each stepping by 4 per entry). On a mapped case it writes the team id to a1+8 and the result of sub_414180(1) to a1+12 and returns 1; otherwise it returns -1. The mapping runs only when a2 equals 1 and the flag a4 is zero.

operations.description: The mapping runs only when a2 equals 1 and the flag a4 is zero; the result starts at -1.
Resolves the season database path as dword_7D0434, or byte_5EA438 when that pointer is null.
sub_588410 compares the resolved path against the F11999.GDB filename literal; when it does not match the function falls through and returns -1.
The path is probed against the F12000.GDB filename literal; a non-match selects the team-id table with base 334.
The path is probed against the F12001.GDB filename literal; a non-match selects the team-id table with base 335.
The path is probed against the F12002.GDB filename literal; absence of a match selects the table with base 333 while a match selects the table with base 336.

Switch on a3 dispatches through one of the four compiler jump tables (0x00413EFC, 0x00413F40, 0x00413F84, 0x00413FC8); for cases 1-17 the resulting team id is the selected base (333, 334, 335 or 336) plus 4 times (a3 minus 1); the default case returns -1.
On a mapped case, evaluates sub_414180 with argument 1.
Writes the mapped team id to a1+8 and the sub_414180 result to a1+12, and sets the function result to 1.
Returns 1 after a successful mapping; returns -1 for an unmatched season path, an out-of-range team index, or an absent F11999.GDB.

unresolved: The mapping of the four jump-table globals (0x00413EFC, 0x00413F40, 0x00413F84, 0x00413FC8) to the four season-file switch tables is not asserted; only the selected base ids (333/334/335/336) are confirmed from the case literals.
